# Whizzly Lab

> Whizzly Lab is an elite AI engineering studio and full-stack software development collective. We design, architect, and deploy intelligent AI systems, autonomous multi-agent pipelines, RAG systems, workflow automation, scalable SaaS platforms, full-stack web development, mobile & web apps, digital products, and custom AI integration.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI & RAG Systems**: Multi-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous AI agents, LLM fine-tuning, Hugging Face deployments, and hallucination guardrails.
- **Real-Time Data Pipelines**: Distributed event streaming using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and PySpark for high-throughput anomaly detection, ETL, and fraud prevention.
- **Full-Stack Platforms**: Modern web applications, authenticated dashboards, and microservices built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI/Flask), Docker, and AWS/Cloud native infra.
- **Machine Learning & MLOps**: Supervised & deep neural network models, continuous evaluation loops, model registry, monitoring, and automated retraining pipelines.
- **Technical Enablement & Workshops**: Specialized engineering workshops on RAG architecture, agentic workflows, Kafka streaming, and production MLOps.

## Flagship Case Studies & Production Builds
- **EchoSense**: Real-time crisis intervention NLP pipeline utilizing Kafka and Spark NLP to detect high-priority signals, with vector RAG and Hugging Face deployment (70% faster signal detection).
- **CureCMS Solution**: AI-powered medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) system engineered for healthcare providers with strict HIPAA compliance.
- **COMPLYSECOPS**: Cybersecurity and compliance consulting platform featuring an AI assistant for compliance documentation (saving engineering teams 15+ hours weekly).
- **OXO Packaging**: Custom high-volume e-commerce platform with automated quote calculation, bulk wholesale ordering, and Stripe integration (handling 500+ daily orders).
